claims.claim: Flutter has consistent rendering and strong performance
claims.why: The measurements cover only HTTP server frameworks. The one Dart entry, dart-shelf, is a server, so it says nothing about Flutter's speed on a phone.

claims.claim: Flutter is clearly stronger than React Native for custom rendering, heavy animation and games
claims.about: Flutter vs React Native (mobile UI frameworks)
claims.why: No mobile UI framework was benchmarked, so this comparison can't be checked against the data.
